programme.desc: A unique episode in it’s own right, this episode features a road trip through California, Luxe Travels style; however, the focus this time around is not necessarily on luxury, it’s more about adventures and explorations on the road. Host Sophie Ashley tours around the Golden State, making stops in iconic destinations like San Francisco, Los Angeles, Monterey, and Santa Barbara. Her ride for the episode, true to the Island Hunter style is the iconic Aston Martin DB11 Volante

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Philippines/ Maldives Special"
programme.desc: Elise Ducan showcases Philippine's best resorts in El Nido Palawan; to continue on the theme of luxury travel, she heads to Maldives to explore 2 of the finest properties there; Shangri La and COMO Maalifushi

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Challenges"
programme.desc: Still reeling from the blow to their budget, can Hastings couple Joe & Maria regroup and find a home? And in Wellington Americans Bonnie & Matt want a warm, dry home for their family and they’ve come up with a bold plan…

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Race for the Place"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Race for the Place
programme.desc: Will Bonnie and Matt’s dreams of prefab living come true or will it all come crashing down? And in Hamilton, animal lovers Monique and Chris need to find their first home in a hurry…

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "A Seller's Market"
programme.desc: Young professionals Martin & Helena face up to the complexities of the Christchurch housing market and South Aucklanders Shandel and Steven battle spiralling prices as they search for a family home.

programme.title: Beyond Borders
programme.desc: Discover unknown corners of the world in our new show 'Beyond Borders'! Join our dynamic duo for an unforgettable journey filled with adventures, culture, and breathtaking views.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Extreme Sports in New Zealand, Ghost Tours in Savannah, and the World’s Most Exotic Hotels"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Extreme Sports in New Zealand, Ghost Tours in Savannah, and the World’s Most Exotic Hotels
programme.desc: Experience skydiving and bungeejumping in New Zealand before checking into the world’s most bizarre hotels and hunting for ghosts in Savannah.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "West Coast Road Trip: From California to Alaska"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 West Coast Road Trip: From California to Alaska
programme.desc: Travel from Hollywood's stars to Alaska's rugged wilds, scaling Redwoods, surfing Pacific breakers, and mushing sled dogs on an epic coastal journey.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "What’s Hot in Chile"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E03 What’s Hot in Chile
programme.desc: Explore a land of extreme contrasts, from the bone-dry Atacama Desert to snowy volcanoes, where ancient history meets vibrant, modern South City life.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S3 - "St. Martin"
programme.desc: St. Martin, "The Friendly Island" of the French Caribbean, with its blend of warm hospitality and European style.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Martinique"
programme.desc: Denella travels to the French Caribbean Island of Martinique where she learns how to sail aboard a traditional YOLE boat.

programme.title: Traveling with Denella S4 - "Nassau"
programme.desc: Denella travels to Nassau.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "We Bought a Resort (Part 1)"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E25 We Bought a Resort (Part 1)
programme.desc: Sofie heads back to Belize to help husband and wife team Rachel and Ben size up some properties. Along with their investors, the couple are looking to purchase a resort on the island of Ambergris Caye that will provide the most bang for their buck.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S2 - "We Bought a Resort (Part 2)"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E26 We Bought a Resort (Part 2)
programme.desc: Each with a big personality of their own, it becomes clear this couple is not going to see eye to eye on what they want. Luckily for them, Sofie is a pro at mediating conflicts when it comes to real estate.

programme.title: Top Million Dollar Agent S3 - "Net Zero"
programme.desc: Julie and James are looking for a new home to raise their two boys. James is in the tech industry and would love an energy efficient home. Julie has her own dance studio and can't wait to get back to work after giving birth to her second son.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Rennes (Brittany) & Provo (Turks & Caicos)"
programme.desc: This gastronomic tour of Brittany stops off for a crêpe in Renne, Oysters in Cancale and some fine wines in the Turks and Caicos Caribbean islands.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Stockholm & Lisbon"
programme.desc: For a snow capped winter break without the slopes, The Luxury Travel Show heads to Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Then it’s time of some summer sun in Portugal’s beautiful capital city of Lisbon.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show S1 - "Amboise (The Loire) & Grenada"
programme.desc: Culture and pampering, fine wines and the final resting place of Leonardo da Vinci in the Loire Valley in France and the ultimate relaxing spa break in Grenada.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: The Luxe Travels season starts off in the beautiful and highly popular tourism hotspot; Bali. The host, Liesel Hlista embarks on a mission to understand how the Balinese blend hospitality with luxury.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: An uncommon destination for a series that explores exotic tropical getaways. But this island nation has some of the most evocative landscapes that mother nature has to offer!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Jamaica"
programme.desc: Easy island vibes, lots of amazing local rum, brilliant natural landscapes and those amazing beaches! Of course,Luxe Travels is in Jamaica! But in this episode, host Liesel Hlista shows you a different side of the Irie nation; away from the hordes of people unleashed via cruise liners!

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "The Loire V Anuradhapura (Sri Lanka)"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 The Loire V Anuradhapura (Sri Lanka)
programme.desc: Gill embarks on more than a wine tasting tour of France as Amboise is also the former residence of the French royal family. Meanwhile Richard embarks on his own historical tour of Sri Lanka, visiting some the islands ancient temples and ruins.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "Florence V Northern Ireland"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 Florence V Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Richard attempts Jet Set crowning glory from the seat of the Iron Throne when he visits some of the Game of Thrones filming locations in Northern Ireland. While in the Italian city of Florence Gill visits Michael Angelo’s famous statue of David.

programme.title: Jet Set S1 - "St Lucia V Uga Bay Passekudah (Sri Lanka)"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 St Lucia V Uga Bay Passekudah (Sri Lanka)
programme.desc: Dave has a difficult choice of who wins this episode as both Gill and Richard are in their own tropical paradise islands. Gill in the Caribbean island of St Lucia and Richard in Sri Lanka. Each boasting miles of soft golden sands and warm seawaters.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Ranch Life - Texas"
programme.desc: Sometimes exploring the road less traveled gives you the biggest adventure. In this episode, we escape the city buzz and opt for a quieter life on a Texas ranch. Taking time to appreciate the beauty in history, animals and quality time as a family.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Luxury With Purpose - Belize"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 Luxury With Purpose - Belize
programme.desc: Join us on an epic adventure to a remote private island in Belize. As we spend our days catching lobsters, diving the worldclass reef and enjoying coconuts straight from the tree. We also learn about how much our tourism dollars really count.

programme.title: Big Little Footprints S1 - "Daring Dive into Conservation - Fiji"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Daring Dive into Conservation - Fiji
programme.desc: We travel to an island resort in Fiji known for it’s daring shark encounters! To hear and see first hand the amazing conservation work they’re doing. Along the way we meet the local school kids and learn about how they’re helping protect the reef.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "The Coolest Places to See Wildlife: Tanzania, the Great Barrier Reef, and the Amazon Rainforest"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 The Coolest Places to See Wildlife: Tanzania, the Great Barrier Reef, and the Amazon Rainforest
programme.desc: Track big cats in the Serengeti, dive the Technicolor Great Barrier Reef, and venture by boat into the heart of the biodiverse Amazon Rainforest.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "America’s National Parks"
programme.desc: Motor across the USA to climb Yosemite’s cliffs, witness Yellowstone’s geysers, and solve the mystery of the moving stones in scorched Death Valley.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Top and Bottom: The World Above the 60th Parallel and Below"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E06 Top and Bottom: The World Above the 60th Parallel and Below
programme.desc: Plot a course for the world's extremes, using ice breakers and bush planes to explore northern Canada, Iceland, Tasmania, and the tip of Argentina.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Zagreb (Croatia) x Fish & Chips"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Zagreb (Croatia) x Fish & Chips
programme.desc: In landlocked Zagreb, Jack swaps potatoes for sauerkraut to serve a localized fish and chips to curious locals and government officials.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Darwin (Australia) x Potted Shrimp"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E02 Darwin (Australia) x Potted Shrimp
programme.desc: With no shrimp in Darwin, Jack pivots to mudcrab and crocodile meat to reinvent his Cornwall recipe for a tropical Australian crowd.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Cairns, QLD"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to Cairns, Australia where he embarks on an adventure to the rainforests of Mission Beach. Learning from locals, he learns how to hunt mud crabs with a spear on the traditional fishing grounds of the Kuku Yalanji people.

programme.title: Khanh Ong's Wild Food S1 - "Eyre Peninsula, SA"
programme.desc: Chef Khanh Ong travels to the spectacular Eyre Peninsula, South Australia. In shark infested waters he conquers his fears and jumps in to learn how to hunt underwater. From locals he learns how to spear fish and four-wheel drive through sand dunes.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Tristan 'Shu' Lebeschu"
programme.desc: Renowned winter photographer, Tristan Shu, attempts his dream project; a photograph that combines astrophotography with action sports. His aim is to capture ski and snowboard tricks at night, set against the Milky-way and the spectacular Mont-Blanc.

programme.title: Capturing Winter S1 - "Aurélie Gonin"
programme.desc: Aurélie Gonin is one of the few women working in winter action sports filmmaking. Over the years she gathered expertise in every aspect of her field. We join as she directs an elite ski and snowboarding qualification event of the Freeride World Tour.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Collision Chaos"
programme.desc: The ride takes a dramatic turn when Bhaskar totals the support car. With Ridermania just days away, Jess and the team scramble to salvage their journey, redistributing luggage onto their bikes. They push on through Karnataka, reaching Gokarna’s beaches, only for another setback to hit when a rider is caught in a collision.

programme.title: Roads Unknown India S1 - "Ridermania"
programme.desc: After a crash leaves Zombie injured, the crew scrambles to stay on schedule for Ridermania. Jess arrives at the festival, participates in events and is met with overwhelming support from fans and fellow riders. The three-day celebration ends with a visit to a famous Goa beach before the crew heads to Ganpatipule.

programme.title: Streetfood Nomad: Kolkata S1 - "The Original Fast Food"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E05 The Original Fast Food
programme.desc: In a vibrant exploration of textures and tastes, Will dives into the world of Indian street food chats and snacks, some of the most loved and sought after dishes in all of India. The original fast food.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Back to where it all started"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E10 Back to where it all started
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave are reaching the end of their incredible journey and must go back to where it all started Buenos Aires.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "6000 km"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave make a toast to their recently finished trip rough riding across Argentina.

programme.title: Roads End S1 - "Re-live"
programme.desc: In this episode Rob and Dave re-live some more of the highlights from their incredible 6000km journey.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: A nation of gregarious people that loves their libations; a fantastic whiskey tasting at Teeling in Dublin makes Jonathan wonder, what happened to Irish whiskey? How did it lose the crown to Scotland? To find out, he gets an adventure bike and charts course on a new mission to find out.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Russia"
programme.desc: Russia, the nation of czars! Jonathan bounces around opulent subway networks, chances upon Russia's legendary space exploration initiative, heads to Grozny for gritty hands on combat, and so much more!

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Arizona"
programme.desc: Classic Western scenery; vast moonscape-like red terrain, this is the land of cowboys! With a fully outfitted 4x4 and a whisper silent electric bike, Jonathan is dead set on finding the Lost Dutchman’s mine.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "New Plymouth"
programme.desc: Piri’s on the West Coast in Taranaki, to target tuna and kahawai. He also goes eeling with kaumatua Hone Niwa and he hits the skids with Sean Potroz the young NZ D1 drifting champion.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Tuhua Island"
programme.desc: Piri dives and fishes on Tuhua Island and local kaitiaki of the island, Shirley Mato, shares some history.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Waihau Bay"
programme.desc: Piri goes sky high in a chopper to go deer spotting. He also heads down to Ruatoria to join the Ngati Porou East Coast Womens team for a very special pre-season training camp.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Coober Pedy"
programme.desc: Chris is going underground; from the caves of Coober Pedy to accommodation with a difference in the Blue mountains.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Valentine's Day"
programme.desc: Chris helps a friend arrange a romantic Valentines Day for his partner and gives viewers the run down of his top five most romantic Australian beaches.

programme.title: Travels with the Bondi Vet S2 - "Melbourne"
programme.desc: Chris visits Melbourne for a series of challenges that celebrate the city’s food, football and street art culture.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Gabon"
programme.desc: Most of safari Africa is populated with the megafauna we see regularly on TV—lions, savannah elephants, Nile Crocodiles, Cape Buffalo to name a few. There is one area of the African rainforest where that isn’t the case.

programme.title: Travel Quest S2 - "Dubai & Abu Dhabi"
programme.desc: Bill has three quests—to go to the top of the tallest building in the world, to track rare desert wildlife especially the oryx, and to step back in time before the gleaming, ultra-modern skyscrapers when the locals lived a nomadic Bedouin lifestyle.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "Brazil…The Amazon"
programme.desc: Seeing a jaguar in the wild is nearly impossible but working with one of the leading jaguar experts, Bill assists in a prey/predator study to get the best chance. In the process, he comes literally face to face with an 18 foot long Amazon Anaconda.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Ashique's Italy"
programme.desc: Ashique surprises the team with Vespa rides along the coast, adapts plans with an aquarium visit, and arranges a Fiat 500 countryside drive. The day ends with relaxation at a Roman spa.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Inside Ferrari"
programme.desc: The trio are joined by Mathias Lauda, son of F1 Legend Niki Lauda, at Ferrari’s Maranello HQ. From factory tours showcasing Ferrari’s craftsmanship to dining in Ferrari’s historic restaurant, the team immerses in Ferrari’s legacy.

programme.title: Car & Country Quest S1 - "Inside Ferrari 2"
programme.desc: Freddie leads an exclusive Ferrari tour, as they explore Ferrari’s design centre, visit its museum, and honour F1 champions. A friendly race in the Ferrari simulator and a scenic drive in new Ferraris close their Italian adventure beautifully.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 1"
programme.desc: Kevin travels to Switzerland and has 24 hours to go from Zurich to the Swiss mountains, while Jalou finds an exciting way to go from Cannes to Corsica.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 2"
programme.desc: Jalou has 24 hours to get from Barcelona to Tarragona where she conquers the Catalonian mountains with her mountain bike. Kevin tries to beat her in Slovenia.

programme.title: 7 Days S1 - "Day 3"
programme.desc: Kevin leaves civilization behind in Suriname, while thousands of kilometers away, Jalou has to go literally through the trees in an Australian forest.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Serbia"
programme.desc: Jonathan is on a mission to trace the Danube river; the same path taken by his immigrant ancestors from Germany. His journey starts underneath the massive Kalemegdan fortress,to uncover Atilla the Hun’s supposed grave. It continues on, to unearth a story on the theme of welcoming immigrants; the Middle Eastern refugees.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Hong Kong"
programme.desc: Jonathan Legg is in Asia’s world city, Hong Kong! With all things opulent and luxurious; high end art collectors to the priciest wines in the world, super car aficionados and helicopter getaways from skyscraper rooftops; this is the road less traveled from a different point of view.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S4 - "Mexico"
programme.desc: Jonathan begins his theme of exploration on all things the Spanish Conquistadores could not suppress.From the ancient bitter drink of Chocolatl, to the world’s fastest growing religion, Santa Muerte. Between delicious foods at taco stands to exploring bustling markets in Mexico City.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Fiordland"
programme.desc: On a commercial crayfish boat with Skipper Storm Waldrop (Ngati Mamoe) & deckhand Dan Wright (Ngai Tahu), they target Tuna, dive for paua and kina, and bring up commercial cray pots in this untouched paradise.

programme.title: Piri’s Tiki Tour S5 - "Kapiti"
programme.desc: On the Kapiti Coast, Piri and keen fisherman, Jason Huria, target snapper and tarakihi. Piri jumps on a twin hulled waka with Te Wera Henare to sail out to Kapiti island.

programme.title: Life as a Miao Silversmith
programme.desc: In this episode, Eva May steps into Maliao Village — a century-old silversmith village nestled in Leishan, Guizhou Province. Over the course of a week, she dives into the craft and daily lives of Miao men who carry on the silversmithing legacy. She works side by side with local silversmiths day in and day out, delving into the culture and techniques behind Miao silverware. She even joins master silversmiths for a live-stream event, before engaging in discussions with university professors about how traditional craftsmanship can fuel rural revitalization. On top of that, she witnesses the breathtaking sight of "maidens adorned in silver and flowers" at the grand Miao New Year celebrations,...

programme.title: World Heritage in China: Ancient City of Pingyao
programme.desc: Established in the 14th century, Pingyao retains the typical layout of the county-level cities of the Han people in Central China. The ancient city is a complete community comprising walls, streets and lanes, shops, houses and temples.?As a UNESCO World Heritage site, Pingyao remains a testament to traditional Chinese urban planning and architecture, attracting visitors from around the world who seek to explore its historical streets and vibrant history.

programme.title: Ancient tradition in an old town takes on new life
programme.desc: The Chinese lion dance is an art form that combines acrobatics, dance, folk music and embroidery. The southern style lion dance was a staple in the ancient town of Qiantong before the costume faded in the early 20th century. However, now the tradition has been revived by some incredible talented young people from this town.

programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast....

programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? programme.title: Fiery Tales of the Daliang Mountains
programme.desc: In this episode, our host takes you to Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in Sichuan Province, to celebrate the most traditional Torch Festival with the local Yi people. Water nourishes the farmland; fire brings light and warmth. Water and fire are the two essential elements that sustain the life of the Yi people. Puge County is known as the birthplace of the Yi Torch Festival. Our host travels across mountains to the remote heart of Puge County, in search of the origins of the Yi torch, to learn about local daily life, explore the profound Yi culture, and visit a Yi family to share a special “reunion dinner” on the eve of the Torch Festival—just like their own New Year's Eve feast....

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-1 Baji Quan
programme.desc: In the first episode of Season 2 of Kung Fu Wise, Baji Quan, host Kleber travels to Mengcun, Cangzhou, in Hebei Province. programme.title: Foodwise: Great Walls of Beijing
programme.desc: The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling
programme.desc: In Episode 2, Chinese Wrestling, host Kleber joins a public training session led by Wang Tongqing, a master preserving the imperial Shanpu Ying wrestling tradition. Swept up in the group’s lively atmosphere, he gets a first-hand feel for the master’s skill.Kleber then invites his Italian friend Paolo to train systematically, uncovering how Chinese wrestling principles connect with other martial arts, from Tai Chi to Wing Chun. Through Master Wang’s story of bringing a formerly imperial martial art into the public sphere, mentoring the next generation, and hoping to take it onto the international stage, the episode shows wrestling as more than a test of strength. It is a cultural bridge...

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in...

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Young star on green field
programme.desc: Meet Sun Chenxi, a 12-year-old soccer "star" from Ningbo who first picked up the game at the age of four and is already playing with the confidence of a veteran. Sun says he dreams of turning pro one day and leading China's men's team to the World Cup. Dribbling and passing with skills far more advanced than his age, he has won over audiences far and wide after his father posted clips of Sun flashing his fancy footwork on social media. The soon-to-be-teenager now has millions of followers online. Already recognized as a rising young talent, high hopes are pinned on Sun as he is cheered on by his parents, friends, and throngs of fans online.

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor.We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins.It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-2 Chinese Wrestling

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in...

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Quanzhou Puppet Theater: China’s "Pinocchio Adventure"
programme.desc: In the film, the puppet Pinocchio, carved and created by an old carpenter, comes to life as a real human. Puppets are lifeless by nature—it is the masterful skills of their puppeteers’ fingertips that breathe life into them. What does China’s own "Pinocchio Adventure" look like? This episode takes you into the world of Quanzhou String Puppet Theater. Explore behind-the-scenes stories, from the intricate carving of puppet heads to the art of puppet performance, and witness how the dance of ten fingers and threads weaves a thousand vivid characters to life!

programme.title: Escape to Yibin
programme.desc: Yibin is hailed as "The First City along the Yangtze River", home to renowned Yibin Ranmian noodles and Wuliangye liquor.We explored plenty of lesser-known scenic spots: Lizhuang, the cultural hub during the War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression; vast bamboo groves that embody the hermit culture of China; and the mysterious cliff-hanging coffins.It is precisely these secluded and strategically advantageous lands that enabled local cultures to be well preserved amid turbulent times.

programme.title: World Heritages in Handan
programme.desc: Handan, a renowned historical and cultural city in China, boasts abundant cultural and tourism resources, including the Handan Museum and Congtai Park in Congtai District, as well as the Xiangtangshan Grottoes, Guangfu Ancient City, Cizhou Kiln, etc. Handan also has a long-standing connection with the Beijing-Hangzhou Grand Canal, a world cultural heritage. As a great project created in ancient China, the Grand Canal has not only exerted a profound impact on cities along the route in terms of transportation, economy and culture, but also served as an important driving force for Handan's development.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation

Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-3 Shaolin Style
programme.desc: Episode 3, Shaolin, explores how this thousand-year-old temple has evolved into a unique “kung fu platform” that draws enthusiasts from around the world. Host Kleber immerses himself in Shaolin’s integrated way of life, where Chan (Zen) practice and martial training go hand in hand, and turns the camera toward foreign practitioners pursuing their kung fu dreams both inside and beyond the temple gates.Along the way, he meets international disciples living and training at Shaolin, as well as students learning the rare art of Shaolin Xinyiba under Master Hu Zhengsheng, a former Shaolin monk. At martial arts schools near Songshan Mountain, Kleber also encounters overseas competitors training...

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. It is a site of an ancient city, ancient kingdom and ancient Shu culture in southwest of China, which is the largest in area, longest in time span and richest in cultural connotation. The total area covers 12 square kilometers, which was built over 3000 years ago. The cultural relics at Sanxingdui are precious cultural heritage of mankind, which contain rich historical, cultural and scientific value, and bespeak themselves as the most attractive ones amongst the multitude of the spectacular relics in China.In this episode, under the guide of the presenter, we visit the Sanxingdui Site Garden, archaeological Site and Sanxingdui...

programme.title: Valentine’s for the Pumi People
programme.desc: In this episode, we record the grand celebration of the traditional Pumi Valentine's Day in Luoguqing, Lanping County, Yunnan Province. Every year, on the fifth day of the fifth lunar month, young men and women from the local community gather on the vast meadows of Luoguqing to take part in singing and dancing activities in pursuit of marriage. During the program, the host interacts with local people of the Pumi and other ethnic groups, showcasing the traditional plateau lifestyle of the Pumi people, their distinctive firepit culture, as well as the community’s brand-new look in the new era. All these scenes unfold against the lively backdrop of the Valentine’s Day activities, fostering a...

programme.title: World Heritages in China: A Journey on Water from Wuxi to Yixing
programme.desc: Water has always been the heartbeat of human civilization, nurturing the cities it weaves through. From the first drops that carved out its waterways to the thriving metropolis we see today, Wuxi’s story is inseparable from the grand canal. This is the story of a city born of water. In this episode, we uncover how the waters have shaped Wuxi’s identity.

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: Quanzhou Nanyin: A Living Fossil in the History of Chinese Music
programme.desc: Nanyin, also known as “Quanzhou Nanyin,” is an ancient Han Chinese musical tradition whose singing style preserves the time-honored ethnic vocal techniques predating the Tang Dynasty, earning it the title of “a living fossil in the history of Chinese music.”The program features Yegor, a Ukrainian music enthusiast, visiting Master Su Shuyong, a Nanyin inheritor, to hear her decades-long stories of teaching this art. They also tour the Quanzhou Nanyin Troupe, where, led by its artistic director Zhuang Lifen, they learn about the basic performance formats and instruments of Nanyin. Additionally, the episode follows a post-1990s Nanyin performer, Zheng Mingming, as she sips tea with guests...

programme.title: Basketball dreams soar in Liangshan
programme.desc: Meet basketball girl Aguolieha, who comes from a rural village in the mountainous Liangshan Yi Autonomous Prefecture in southwest China. Playing for a local team called the Blackhawks, the 13-year-old has a big dream: to become a professional player one day and join Team China. At first, her father was not supportive as he feared that sports training would make her grades fall. Proving to be excellent both academically and on the court, she often looks up to her idol Stephen Curry, and trains hard with her peers. She believes that the sky's the limit and that basketball games will help her dreams soar.

programme.title: Sanxingdui: Rediscovering a Lost Civilisation
programme.desc: Sanxingdui Site is located at Guanghan, Sichuan Province. programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished.In the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. programme.title: China Highly Recommended: Changsha
programme.desc: Episode 1 of Travelogue's "China Highly Recommended" tells the story of Changsha, one of China's happiest cities. Following the lives of four of its foreign residents: A French executive chef, a Japanese podcaster, and two American teachers, we discover the reasons why they made Changsha their second home, and explore the city with them as only locals do. This episode will be released as a 30 minute travel documentary to be broadcast on CGTN's television channel and social media platform, along with a series of video clips and photos

programme.title: Valentine's with the Snake King
programme.desc: Every year on Qixi Festival (Chinese Valentine's Day), the town of Zhanghu in Nanping, Fujian Province hosts a folk custom event: the Snake King Parade. Local residents carry the statue of the Snake King from the temple, along with specially prepared pythons, and parade through the streets and alleys. Wherever the procession passes, residents and shopkeepers greet them with firecrackers and burn incense to pray, hoping to receive the unique blessing of the Snake King. This distinctive folk activity is rarely seen elsewhere across China. programme.title: A Sip of Mount Wuyi
programme.desc: Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun)—a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoxing
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in the historic water town of Shaoxing, famed for its yellow wine. Traversing its canals by boat, Tianran discovers why it's said there are 10,000 bridges in Shaoxing, before enjoying the freshest catch of the day. But as it turns out, Shaoxing's climate is also perfect for fermentation, leading to a wide array of unique local foods that can sometimes be both smelly and delicious – and at other times, downright unforgettable!

programme.title: Celebrating the Corban Festival
programme.desc: Kashgar, situated in the southwest of Xinjiang, was a key stop on the ancient Silk Road. It served as a gateway for trade between China and countries in Asia and Europe. However, it wasn’t only goods that were exchanged on the Silk Road. So, too, were cultures, which merged and flourished.In the 7th century AD, Islam entered China’s western regions along the Silk Road, bringing with it the Corban Festival. With time, Corban became more than a religious festival. It developed into a traditional holiday celebrated by everyone in Kashgar.Corban is as important as New Year. Kashgar locals load their tables with food on this day to reward themselves for a year of hard work. Corban is all...

programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Last preps

Coralie and Florent are still walking on clouds as they wait for their daughter, Lena. So are Nathalie and Naoufel, who arrange a tour of the future baby’s bedroom. Things are still tense between Kim and her parents. Her father blames here for having left school too early and the family makes no effort to hide their dislike of Pierre, the would-be father, who is still a no-show. They go as far as opposing Kim’s preferred choice for the future boy’s name, since it was his father that came up with the idea...

programme.title: My Zen Family - Season 1 - Welcome in a new world
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Welcome in a new world

Was Coralie allowed her much-desired epidural? Did Pierre came back at Kim’s side to finally act as the father, and what name did Kim settle upon for her son? In the end, it is Nathalie and Naoufel, our most experienced parents, who share with us some words of wisdom: “one isn’t just born being a parent, one has to learn it.”

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Nature’s Heroes: Gabon - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Nature’s Heroes: Gabon - Part 1
programme.desc: How can we reconcile the development needed to sustain the lives of nearly seven billion people with the protection of the Earth's natural resources? Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team have chosen Gabon to continue their survey of the planet. We'll be discovering the Kongou Falls, the Langoué clearing with their elephant in Gabon. Then in Colombia, we will go on the island of Malpelo with their shark. Back to Gabon we will discover the Minkébé National Park and the bats in Franceville. We will also go to India in Hyderabad, which has convinced farmers to use no pesticides and no GMOs in their cultivation.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - Citrus flavors
programme.desc: Julie takes you through the Pyrénées Orientales, then Corsica, before making a stop on the Côte d'Azur, and concludes her journey between Rungis and Paris... all to explore the world of citrus fruits! These fruits add flavor, zest, and seasoning to any recipe, making them indispensable in the kitchen. They bring the warmth and sunshine of the South of France and the exoticism of distant lands. While we're all familiar with lemons, clementines, and grapefruits, Julie introduces us to a thousand other varieties.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Carine (Nice)
programme.desc: After twenty years as a lawyer, Carine decided to give in to her desire to help others heal. Her inner journey led her to discover a passion for naturopathy as she rediscovered her love for nature and learned the healing qualities of the plants around her. Combined with a deep understanding of astrology and nutrition, she is now able to help others live better and find their own path.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Virginie (Lyon)
programme.desc: Virginie’s beautiful handwritten lettering decorates the walls and windows of many shops in and around Lyon, France, as she lives out her passion of finding beauty in every stroke. A former waitress, Virginie was struggling to find her calling when she suffered a life-altering horse accident that almost left her handicapped. At only 30, she was forced to put her whole life into perspective. She finally found herself through a love for graphic design and lettering, combined with a desire for freedom that came with working independently. To motivate other women, she has also launched “Ladyboss”, a network of inspiring women entrepreneurs.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Laetitia (French Alps)
programme.desc: While pregnant with her daughter, Laetitia, a former journalist, experienced a strong desire to change lifestyles and move to the countryside. Remembering the teachings of her grandmother, she began to venture outdoors into the surrounding Alps and study the different plants at her fingertips. Today she holds a wealth of knowledge about the medicinal and aromatherapeutic value of plants that she applies to making natural products. With utmost respect for the environment, Laetitia gathers only what she needs in order to make herbal infusions.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Louise (Oleron Island)
programme.desc: At only 20 years old, Louise is full of confidence and already achieved a personal dream of hers to share her passion for nutritious and locally-sourced ingredients on the island of Oleron, France. Repurposing a camping car, she set up a brunch and tea-time spot where the guests can hand-pick their ingredients in the adjacent organic fields. Louise transforms the ingredients into favourite creations of hers and even joins her father for boat trips when she needs to stock up on fresh fish for the menu!

programme.title: Earth from above - Season 3 - Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Japan: Mass consumption - What the labels forget to mention - Part 1
programme.desc: In this instalment, Yann Arthus-Bertrand lifts the veil on the products people buy. Almost everything we buy has a direct impact on our environment. We head to Japan to talk about the impact of new technologies, then to the Republic of Congo in Bukavu for the coltan harvest. How does our total consumption affect the environment? What permanent brands are we imposing on our planet? How can we differentiate between useful and useless purchases?

programme.desc: Above all, these reports are an opportunity for Yann Arthus-Bertrand to take stock of the planet and denounce certain human behaviors that are at the root of dramatic, even irreversible, environmental and climatic degradation. Off to Tokyo, then Kenya, to an animal sanctuary. Then on to Mount Fuji to learn how to live there, and all the plastic that clogs up the seas. Reports will focus on everyday products, chosen for their destructive production practices for both people and the environment.

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - The taste of bread
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 The taste of bread
programme.desc: Today, Julie takes you on a bread trail to uncover the dedicated artisan bakers and millers. Her adventure will lead her through the Libourne region, then onwards to the North of France, the Ardèche, and the Aisne, where bakers have transformed bread into a powerful catalyst for social cohesion. While some individuals may avoid bread, particularly due to gluten-related concerns, others have chosen to reposition it at the forefront of the dining experience by championing its nutritional benefits. This commitment is shared by several chefs whom Julie will meet at the conclusion of her expedition.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Juliette (Morbihan)
programme.desc: Juliette has long been aware of the delicate beauty of nature. For years she spent her life on the sea, organising regattas for the traditional sailboats that are famous in the French region of Morbihan. Her appreciation for the elements made for a smooth transition as she decided to leave the water behind and return to the earth. Learning to shape a ball of clay into a graceful and elegant object, she discovered a passion for ceramics. Today, she lives from her creations and makes pieces that reflect their surroundings, the stunning Gulf of Morbihan.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Anna (Brittany)
programme.desc: Anna’s unusual background provided inspiration for her life change. Her career began as a wolf trainer for cinema and it was during these years that she developed her deep love for animals. After being tired of seeing them used as props and constantly in cages, she decided to leave the world of show business behind and start an eco-friendly sheep and goat pasture. To further share her passion for these gentle animals, Anna has opened a conservatory farm where visitors can experience first-hand the joys of being close to nature. She also makes amazing goat cheese!

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Cristina (Spain)
programme.desc: At 31 years old, the last thing Cristina expected when she went to see the doctor about a blocked ear was to leave the consultation with a diagnosis for Breast Cancer. This young and passionate sociologist decided to apply the same philosophy to her treatment as she did when surfing: when a wave crashes down on you, get up and try again. Through her healing journey she deepened her love for the ocean and also discovered the therapeutic capabilities of yoga for cancer patients. Today she shares her practice through surf and yoga retreats and is specialised in oncological yoga, helping others heal.

programme.title: My Zen People - Season 4 - Idoia (Spain)
programme.desc: Idoia thrives on weaving together the sources of inspiration that surround her. Heavily influenced by the natural beauty of her home region of Galicia, Spain, she creates unique woven pieces from diverse and beautiful materials. Idoia’s pieces represent her vision of a modern woman, drawing from the traditions and experiences of those who perfected the craft before her and also pushing to innovate and adapt her creations for the modern world. Her recent collaboration with luxury fashion house Loewe is a dream come true for this modern artisan.

programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 USA: The end of oil - Part 1
programme.desc: "The end of oil" is the amazing story of a raw material which has revolutionized man's life in just a century. But today, oil reserves are depleting. In his crazy race for always more production, Man didn't manage to preserve this precious energy that took million years for the Earth to give out. To tell the adventure of oil, Yann Arthus-Bertrand and his team went to the United States, the country which depends the most on black gold. At the start of the 21st century, it is now urgent to realize that oil resources are limited. It's today that we have to act and get organized, in order to prepare the new era to come. While all our economies are based on the petrol barrel's price, we'll...

programme.title: Julie's Frenchy Cookbook - Season 4 - A la carte grills
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 A la carte grills
programme.desc: If you're a nature enthusiast and a fan of outdoor cooking, the upcoming season is perfect for barbecue enthusiasts! Our journey will take us to Aube, nestled in the heart of the Brévonnes forest, and then to the Massif des Bauges, where grilling and snow create a unique combination. Afterward, we'll explore the Libournais region, where we'll uncover cooking techniques that make use of vine shoots, which are plentiful in the area. Just a short distance from the vineyards, we'll arrive at another corner of Gironde, the Blaye region, where the cooking method remains consistent but features a distinctly local ingredient: eel.

programme.title: Pal Pal Dil Ke Paas
programme.desc: Orphaned at a young age, Karan Sehgal owns 'Camp Ujhi,' an elite trekking club in Manali. Saher Sethi, a top vlogger, takes up an assignment to review the camp to avoid a family reunion. Suspecting a scam due to high prices, she aims to expose it, but Karan promises a life-changing experience. After a week of thrilling adventures, they fall for each other. Just as everything seems perfect, Saher's ex-boyfriend appears, intent on separating them.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E138 Jodha Akbar S4 E138
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Jodha Akbar
programme.sub-title: S04 : E143 Jodha Akbar S4 E143
programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey decides to battle Rex Raptor without his friends’ help to prove that he is man enough to take care of Serenity on his own. programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey duels valiantly, but Rex Raptor has unleashed his secret weapon: Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Joey must figure out the secret of Yugi’s gift, the Time Wizard card, without Yugi’s help or he’s taking the next boat out of Duelist Kingdom!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E13 Evil Spirit of the Ring
programme.desc: Yugi’s classmate Bakura, possessed by his Millennium Ring’s dark powers, traps Yugi and friends in a Shadow Game where they become the cards themselves! Not only must Yugi battle to avoid becoming a permanent part of the card game, but also free Bakura’s soul from the Millennium Ring’s control!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E14 The Light at the End of the Tunnel
programme.desc: Pegasus’s hired duelist PaniK cheats Mai of all her Star Chips, and Yugi vows to defeat him and win them back. But when PaniK’s Castle of Dark Illusions enshrouds his monsters in a black mist, how can Yugi defeat an enemy he cannot see?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Despite his astonishing disadvantage, Yugi boldly provokes PaniK: “I’ll finish you in three turns.” Is Yugi bluffing, or does he have the advantage in this battle of wits?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E16 The Scars of Defeat
programme.desc: Kaiba descends to the kingdom to face Pegasus! Has Kaiba changed since his battle with Yugi, or is he still the same merciless duelist? A battle between Kaiba’s Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Joey’s Red-Eyes B. Dragon holds the answers!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E17 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 1
programme.desc: The #1 American duelist Bandit Keith’s gang kidnaps Joey to a secret cave with a graveyard playing field. As Yugi and friends search for him, Joey faces Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters which become stronger as they return from the grave! Joey is all alone in the battle this time!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E18 Arena of Lost Souls, Part 2
programme.desc: Joey’s last ditch effort, his lucky Time Wizard card, fails against Bandit Keith’s zombie monsters. But as his lucky streak comes to an end, will his improving skills as a duelist and his love for his sister inspire him to victory?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E19 Double Trouble Duel, Part 1
programme.desc: Trapped in the labyrinth cave, Yugi and friends find an alternate exit, but the door is guarded by Pegasus’s Paradox Brothers. Yugi and Joey will no longer be battling solo; they band together in a team battle against the Paradox Brothers! The battle for all the Star Chips and entrance to Pegasus’s castle is on the line!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E20 Double Trouble Duel, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey pool their strengths and manage to fend off their opponents’ monsters, but things are about to change as the Paradox Brothers summon the almighty Gate Guardian, a monster that reflects all attacks! Is Joey helping Yugi in this duel, or his lack of experience sealing their fate for defeat?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E21 Double Trouble Duel, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi and Joey each unleash their strongest monster, Summoned Skull and Red-Eyes B. Dragon, but their strength pales in comparison to the tremendous power of Gate Guardian. Individually, our heroes have no chance, but they will unleash the greatest power of all: teamwork!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Using the magic of the Millennium Eye, Pegasus traps Mokuba’s soul inside a card right before Kaiba’s eyes! In order to earn the right to challenge Pegasus, Kaiba must first beat Yugi and take his Star Chips. The rematch between Yugi and Kaiba is about to begin!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Kaiba summons Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon, the strongest monster in the game fused from three Blue-Eyes White Dragons! Yugi has lost all his powerful Duel Monsters, but a true duelist never gives up!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Yugi begins spinning a strategy to put Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon to rest, but he must decide whether to claim victory or spare Kaiba his life. Yugi’s heart is split in two!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Having lost his Star Chips to Kaiba and his only opportunity to save Grandpa, Yugi is in a state of shock. Can Téa bring Yugi back to consciousness by defeating Mai for her extra Star Chips and teach Yugi the heart of the duelist?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E26 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi and friends enter the castle to discover Kaiba ready to duel Pegasus with Mokuba’s soul hanging in the balance! The power of the Millennium Eye gives Pegasus the ability to read other people’s minds. Can Kaiba defeat an opponent who knows his moves even before he does?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E27 Champion Vs. Creator, Part 2
programme.desc: Kaiba is helpless against Pegasus’s Toon World deck and mind-reading abilities. As the duel ends, Pegasus imprisons Kaiba’s soul into a card, just like Grandpa and Mokuba! Yugi has had enough!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: T’was the night before the final battle, and many creatures are stirring! Yugi vows to overthrow Pegasus for the sake of his Grandpa. Tristan leads an exploration party to uncover Pegasus’s secrets. While Joey sleeps, Bandit Keith steals from him the card that permits his entry in the final battle!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Under Pegasus’s weighty glare, Yugi is distracted from his duel with Mai. After making foolish tactical errors and allowing Mai to gain a huge advantage with her Harpie's Pet Dragon, will Yugi gather his focus or succumb to the intense pressure?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Mai has rebounded from her previous loss to Joey to become a better duelist. Has Yugi learned from his loss to Kaiba, or is the emotional defeat still weighing on his heart? The answer is in the cards!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: Joey frantically searches for the card that permits him to enter the final battle, not realizing Bandit Keith has stolen it from him. As he struggles to accept the fact that Serenity will be blind forever, he receives help from a new, and unexpected, friend!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: After Bandit Keith’s Machine deck forces Joey to take the defensive, Joey mimics Keith’s battle strategy to metalicize his Red-Eyes B. Dragon! Is victory assured, or does the cheater Bandit Keith literally have one last card up his sleeve?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E33 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 1
programme.desc: With his pride in his strength as a duelist on the line, Joey challenges Yugi for the right to face Pegasus. In a battle between friends, a fierce match ensues between the two people who know each other’s strategies and cards as they struggle to keep their thoughts of past loyalties at the back of their minds.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E34 Best of Friends Best of Duelists, Part 2
programme.desc: Yugi is shocked as Joey uses the Time Wizard card on him, the very card he gave Joey as a sign of friendship! However, as the two battle each other valiantly and one comes out the victor, they find confirmation of the strength of their friendship that surpasses any duel.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E35 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 1
programme.desc: Yugi prepares for the ultimate battle against Pegasus with the souls of Grandpa, Kaiba and Mokuba on the line. Meanwhile, Tristan and Bakura infiltrate the castle to find the Kaiba brothers, but at this crucial moment, is Bakura turning back into his evil self again?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E36 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 2
programme.desc: Pegasus punishes Yugi using the same Toon Deck and mind-reading abilities he used on Kaiba. As Pegasus turns Yugi’s monsters against him, Yugi loses the will to battle. Will Pegasus capture Yugi’s soul into a card, just like Kaiba?

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.sub-title: S01 : E37 Yugi vs. Pegasus Match of the Millennium, Part 3
programme.desc: Yugi has found a counter to Pegasus’s mind-reading ability: Yugi switches back and forth between his two souls! Yugi is able to destroy Pegasus’s Toon World, but the duel has just only begun. The next level of the deadly Shadow Game is about to start!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!
programme.desc: The Pegasus Saga comes to an end, but a new journey is about to begin! Yugi meets a mysterious Egyptian named Shadi who enters Yugi’s mind with the Millennium Key. What are these Millennium Items, and do they hold the answer to the mystery behind the Shadow Games?

programme.desc: Yugi and friends return from the Duelist Kingdom only to meet a young girl named Rebecca who demands that Grandpa return Blue-Eyes White Dragon to her! She’s here to claim back the card that Grandpa stole from her grandfather many years ago!

programme.desc: Rebecca mistakenly believes that Grandpa stole Blue-Eyes White Dragon from her grandfather. Yugi must defend Blue-Eyes White Dragon to teach her that it’s not the power of the cards, but the heart that’s in them that counts.

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! 5 D's
